subtitle: The foundation of good sound. Whether you're a beginner or professional, accurate tuning is essential for musical expression and ear development.

introduction.title: Why Accurate Tuning Matters
introduction.text: Proper tuning is the foundation of all music-making. An out-of-tune guitar sounds unpleasant regardless of playing skill, while a well-tuned instrument makes even simple chords sound musical and inspiring.

columns.title: Musical Benefits
columns.text: Creates harmony and consonance. Enables proper chord intervals. Develops accurate ear training. Allows playing with other musicians. Improves intonation across the neck. Makes practice more enjoyable.

columns.title: Practical Advantages
columns.text: Enables recording and performance. Prevents bad habits from forming. Maintains string tension properly. Extends string life. Builds confidence in playing. Professional presentation.

cards.title: Clip-On Tuners
cards.description: Detect vibrations through guitar body. Clip directly onto headstock with no cables or connections required. Work in noisy environments. Battery-powered, compact and portable.

fields.label: Advantages
fields.value: Convenient and always accessible. Works acoustic and electric guitars. Immune to ambient noise. Inexpensive and reliable. Clear visual display. Perfect for practice and lessons.

fields.label: Top Models
fields.value: Snark SN-5X (popular and affordable), Boss TU-10 (professional build quality), TC Electronic PolyTune Clip (advanced features), D'Addario NS Micro Headstock (ultra-compact)

cards.title: Pedal Tuners
cards.description: Integrate into pedalboard setup with silent tuning (mutes output). Highly accurate detection with bright LED displays for stage use. Multiple tuning modes with buffer and power distribution.

fields.label: Performance Benefits
fields.value: Hands-free operation during performance. Always in signal chain when needed. No audience disruption. Multiple instrument compatibility. Reference tone generation. Professional stage appearance.

fields.label: Industry Standard Pedals
fields.value: Boss TU-3 (most popular stage tuner), TC Electronic PolyTune 3 (polyphonic tuning), Eventide TimeFactor (integrated with effects), Strymon Lex (boutique with premium features)

cards.title: Smartphone & App Tuners
cards.description: Always available on your phone. Free or very inexpensive with advanced features and modes. Metronome integration and custom tuning presets. Visual and audio feedback.

fields.label: Limitations
fields.value: Affected by background noise. Requires quiet environment. Phone microphone quality varies. Battery drain on device. May struggle with electric guitars.

fields.label: Popular Apps
fields.value: Guitar Tuna (most downloaded), Fender Tune (official Fender app), PitchLab (professional features), Chromatic Tuner (simple and effective)

cards.title: Rack & Desktop Tuners
cards.description: Extremely high accuracy with multiple input sources. Reference tone generation and digital/analog outputs. Integration with recording systems and professional calibration options.

fields.label: Features
fields.value: Large, clear displays. Multiple tuning temperaments. Instrument-specific modes. MIDI integration. Calibration to different frequencies. Professional studio standard.

fields.label: Cent
fields.value: 1/100th of a semitone

fields.label: +/-1 cent
fields.value: Extremely accurate (studio grade)

fields.label: +/-3 cents
fields.value: Very good accuracy

fields.label: +/-5 cents
fields.value: Acceptable for most uses

fields.label: +/-10 cents
fields.value: Noticeable but usable

fields.label: >10 cents
fields.value: Obviously out of tune

fields.label: Chromatic Mode
fields.value: Detects any note, most common setting

fields.label: Guitar Mode
fields.value: Only shows standard guitar notes (E-A-D-G-B-E)

fields.label: Strobe Tuning
fields.value: Ultra-precise visual representation

fields.label: Polyphonic
fields.value: Shows all strings at once (strum all strings)

fields.label: Reference Pitch
fields.value: Tune low E to reference, then tune relatively

fields.label: Harmonic Tuning
fields.value: Use natural harmonics for precise intervals

fields.label: Unison Tuning
fields.value: Match notes across different strings

fields.label: Beat Frequency
fields.value: Listen for interference between notes

cards.title: Tuner Considerations
items: Chromatic mode works for all tunings

cards.title: Tune Up, Not Down
cards.description: Always approach the target pitch from below. If you overshoot, tune down past the note and come back up. This accounts for string tension and gearing.

cards.title: Stretch New Strings
cards.description: New strings will go out of tune frequently until they settle. Gently stretch strings and retune several times when changing strings.

cards.title: Check Intonation
cards.description: If open strings are in tune but fretted notes sound off, your guitar's intonation may need adjustment. Compare 12th fret harmonics to fretted notes.

cards.title: Tune Often
cards.description: Check tuning frequently during practice and performance. Temperature changes, string stretching, and playing dynamics all affect tuning stability.
